description: INSTAT Mali publishes about 20 thematic reports from the fifth General Population and Housing Census (RGPH5), carried out in 2022, on its census page. The report on housing characteristics and living environment runs to 180 pages. Its tables give dwellings and their population by type of structure and by main wall, roof and floor material, by urban or rural area and by region, with trends since 1998. Later chapters cover lighting, drinking water, toilets, wastewater and waste disposal and cooking energy, each with regional tables. The report states that nearly three quarters of households had electricity, 38.9 percent through solar panels and 34.4 percent from the EDM grid, which makes it a key source on off-grid solar. A 538-page directory of localities from the same census lists population for every village, fraction and urban quarter by commune. Coverage is national. Format and access: free PDFs, no registration; INSTAT also runs a NADA microdata catalogue. Licence: an INSTAT open data licence agreement allows commercial and non-commercial use under its conditions. Caveats: tables are in PDF; the directory has population only, not services. Simulation uses: solar versus grid electrification and building materials by region for energy access and flood exposure studies. Related records: the WorldPop GRID3 census-based population grids.

provider: Institut National de la Statistique (INSTAT), Mali, Bureau Central du Recensement
schema_summary: Housing report tables (counts and percent): dwellings and population by nature of dwelling and type of structure by urban or rural area and region, trends since 1998, main wall, roof and floor materials by area and region, water supply, sanitation, lighting and electricity source, cooking energy and waste, with annex tables. Locality directory: for each region, circle, commune and locality, population by sex, sex ratio, number of localities and urban or rural flag.
